field_principles.flagged_for_v386: Closes the discover->ingest->plan loop: names the strongest method for the next planner.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. Records ingestion completed with verifiable citations.
field_principles.methods_mapped: Each method/source MUST carry a real arXiv ID/URL (verified); an ingestion note without verifiable citations is treated as fabrication.

methods_mapped.carnot_moat_implication: Majority vote can choose the largest wrong basin, so Carnot should measure external verifier recovery as an additive vote-orthogonal rerank signal, not as a vote replacement.
methods_mapped.diffusiongemma_guidance_implication: Only guide DiffusionGemma after the verifier distinguishes correct minority basins from stable wrong basins on the current stack.
methods_mapped.efficiency_implication: Keep the cheap verifier between fixed vote and LLM-judge: recover oracle headroom only when it improves accuracy per unit compute.
methods_mapped.name: ARBITER reasoning-basin verifier-moat anchor

methods_mapped.carnot_moat_implication: Process verification can beat self-consistency when it checks the reasoning path; Carnot should compare verifier-plus-vote selection against vote and judge baselines.
methods_mapped.diffusiongemma_guidance_implication: Use process-style scores as intermediate guidance signals rather than waiting until the denoised candidate is complete.
methods_mapped.efficiency_implication: ThinkPRM sets the LLM-judge comparison bar: verifier compute must scale better than asking a large judge to rescore every candidate.
methods_mapped.name: ThinkPRM data-efficient process verifier

methods_mapped.carnot_moat_implication: The verifier should be calibrated as a weighted aggregation term with vote evidence; replacing the vote can throw away useful LLM prior information.
methods_mapped.diffusiongemma_guidance_implication: Expose guidance weights as an ablation knob for mixing base denoising confidence with Carnot verifier energy.
methods_mapped.efficiency_implication: Precompute aggregation weights so the verifier improves test-time scaling without multiplying candidate-generation cost.
methods_mapped.name: Optimal LLM+PRM aggregation

methods_mapped.carnot_moat_implication: Training a verifier/value capability alongside reasoning supports an external-value rerank arm, but the moat claim still requires a vote-plus-verifier head-to-head.
methods_mapped.diffusiongemma_guidance_implication: A learned value head is a plausible reward source for guidance, but it must be checked against executable verifier labels before use.
methods_mapped.efficiency_implication: The next efficiency gate should compare a cheap verifier/value head against LLM-judge rescoring under matched parallel sampling.
methods_mapped.name: RLV unified reasoner-verifier value head

methods_mapped.carnot_moat_implication: EntRGi is not moat evidence by itself; it becomes relevant only after Carnot proves the external reward/verifier is discriminative.
methods_mapped.diffusiongemma_guidance_implication: Use entropy-aware interpolation between soft token relaxations and hard tokens as the template for Carnot energy over DiffusionGemma.
methods_mapped.efficiency_implication: Guidance can spend verifier calls during denoising, so the .386 gate must report reward-call cost versus post-hoc judge rescoring.
methods_mapped.name: EntRGi entropy-aware reward guidance

methods_mapped.carnot_moat_implication: Executable world models make verifier-grounded transitions the selection primitive; the moat is action recovery, not just answer selection.
methods_mapped.diffusiongemma_guidance_implication: Treat generated world-model edits as candidates that can be guided or pruned by executable transition energy before acting.
methods_mapped.efficiency_implication: Use RHAE/action efficiency as the cost axis when verifier-pruned planning replaces brute-force exploration.
methods_mapped.name: Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3

methods_mapped.carnot_moat_implication: ARC-AGI-3 makes adaptive efficiency the benchmark target, so the verifier moat must improve actions-to-progress under real rules.
methods_mapped.diffusiongemma_guidance_implication: Guided generation should target compact executable hypotheses and plans, not only fluent natural-language reasoning traces.
methods_mapped.efficiency_implication: Report human-action-normalized efficiency and avoid claims that only improve raw solve count by spending more actions.
methods_mapped.name: ARC-AGI-3 technical report
